general_information.details: Epidemiology and management are discussed in studies 484 and 485.
Timing and associated outcomes with myocardial infarction are addressed in studies 486 and 487.
Their incidence in myocardial infarction and relation to revascularization noted in studies 493-496.
Studies 500-508 discuss implications of drugs and devices in treatment post-arrest.
Clinical efficacy and guidelines are outlined in studies 509-512.
Strategies post-myocardial infarction and surgery are detailed in studies 517, 522, and 523.
